curved_road_rule: A property on the outside or inside of a curved road is not a corner. A cul-de-sac frontage is not a corner. Consecutive road-facing edges that follow one road through a gentle heading change are clustered into a single side. Cul-de-sac bulbs (short consecutive facets) are not treated as intersections. Corner=YES requires two distinct road-facing sides (heading separation >= 35 deg) plus an actual intersection or sharp same-road corner bend.
